security_spec.violation_condition: QEMU's page table walker (get_physical_address) checks the 4-bit RVY PTE field for capability load/store permissions but fails to differentiate between user (pte.u=1) and supervisor (pte.u=0) pages when comparing pte.YRG against sstatus.URG vs sstatus.SRG, causing kernel-page capability read-generation traps to be silently missed or spuriously triggered on the wrong hart-local state
security_spec.summary: PR #933 introduces per-mode capability read-generation bits (URG for user, SRG for supervisor) and a 4-bit RVY PTE field — missing the pte.u-gated sstatus bit selection in QEMU's TCG page table walker allows a guest to bypass kernel-side capability revocation traps, undermining temporal safety enforcement
